_comment: Standalone type-check program for signaling.js / rendezvousSignaling.js ONLY, used by eslint.config.js to run type-aware lint rules on them. These two files are deliberately not in tsconfig.json's include (see kotva-client.pin.json) — this file exists purely so typescript-eslint's `parserOptions.project` has a real TS program to resolve types against, without pulling these two JS files into the main build's type-check surface.
